load_regular_data.name: load_regular_data
load_regular_data.description: Load a continuous subset of oceanographic data from a Zarr dataset along selected dimensions (time, depth, latitude, longitude). Support range-based slicing for regular grids.

load_data_with_geolocator.name: load_data_with_geolocator
load_data_with_geolocator.description: Load ocean data for a specific geographic region using a built-in Geolocator module. The function supports spatial masking by geographic features (e.g., ocean basins, countries, continents) and extracts regular subsets of the target variable across user-defined time and depth ranges.

load_areas.name: load_areas
load_areas.description: Compute precise surface areas of latitude-longitude grid cells on the WGS84 ellipsoid, equivalent to MATLAB’s areaquad function.

load_depth_levels.name: load_depth_levels
load_depth_levels.description: Retrieve standard ocean depth levels and their upper-lower boundaries for reconstruction data.

load_basin_mask.name: load_basin_mask
load_basin_mask.description: Load the WOA23 ocean basin mask defining major basins and sub-basins (e.g., Atlantic, Pacific, Indian, Arctic).

temporal_aggregate.name: temporal_aggregate
temporal_aggregate.description: Aggregate ocean data temporally at different resolutions (monthly, seasonal, annual) for trend analysis and seasonal cycle studies. Supports multiple aggregation operations.

compute_basic_stat.name: compute_basic_stat
compute_basic_stat.description: Perform basic statistical operations along specified dimensions. Support essential descriptive statistics, such as count, max, min, mean, mediam, sum, and area_weighted_mean, for multi-dimensional ocean data.

transform_unit.name: transform_unit
transform_unit.description: Convert the physical units of common oceanographic variables.

detect_outliers.name: detect_outliers
detect_outliers.description: Detect and flag outliers in ocean data for quality control or extreme event identification. Support multiple statistical methods, including zscore, percentile, etc.

fit_1D_trend.name: fit_1D_trend
fit_1D_trend.description: Fit a trend line to a 1D xarray.DataArray using common climate trend models, including linear, quadratic, exponential, and sinusoidal.

fit_multivariate_relation.name: fit_multivariate_relation
fit_multivariate_relation.description: Fit multivariate relationships with one target variable and multiple predictor variables. Supports linear, polynomial, and nonlinear models.

analyze_correlation.name: analyze_correlation
analyze_correlation.description: Calculate correlation coefficients between two ocean variables with flexible dimension handling, lag analysis, and significance testing.

compute_anomaly.name: compute_anomaly
compute_anomaly.description: Compute the anomaly of reconstructed oceanographic data relative to the WOA23 climatology. Support multiple temporal frequencies (month, season, year) and methods (subtract or ratio).

convert_concentration_to_content.name: convert_concentration_to_content
convert_concentration_to_content.description: Convert dissolved tracer concentrations (in μmol/kg) into total content (in mol) by multiplying with seawater density and corresponding grid-cell volume.

compute_vertical_gradient.name: compute_vertical_gradient
compute_vertical_gradient.description: Compute vertical gradient of a variable along the depth dimension using an interface-centered finite-difference scheme.

compute_ratio.name: compute_ratio
compute_ratio.description: Compute the element-wise ratio between two variables, automatically handling divisions by zero.

compute_mixed_layer_depth.name: compute_mixed_layer_depth
compute_mixed_layer_depth.description: Estimate the Mixed Layer Depth (MLD) based on either a density or temperature threshold criterion.

compute_nutricline_depth.name: compute_nutricline_depth
compute_nutricline_depth.description: Determine the nutricline depth as the depth where vertical gradient is maximum.

compute_potential_density_anomaly.name: compute_potential_density_anomaly
compute_potential_density_anomaly.description: Compute the potential density anomaly from in-situ temperature and practical salinity using the TEOS-10 GSW standard.

identify_oxygen_minimum_zone.name: identify_oxygen_minimum_zone
identify_oxygen_minimum_zone.description: Identify Oxygen Minimum Zones (OMZ) with dissolved oxygen concentration data and calculate their thickness. An OMZ is defined as areas where oxygen concentration is below the threshold.

compute_enso_nino_index.name: compute_enso_nino_index
compute_enso_nino_index.description: Calculate the El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) Niño index for a specified region (Niño 1+2, Niño 3, Niño 3.4, and Niño 4) from monthly temperature data.

compute_pdo_index.name: compute_pdo_index
compute_pdo_index.description: Compute Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO) index from sea surface temperature data. PDO is defined as the leading principal component of North Pacific SST anomalies (poleward of 20°N).
